pass_requires: memories accumulate (at least one fact held)
at least one relationship moved away from its prior (changed by an event, not by a prior)
at least one social action (HELP_DECIDED or WARNING_SHARED or AVOID_DECIDED)
no citizen over the memory capacity of 64 facts
identical cognition events and memory/relationship digests over the determinism replay, including the same seeding minute

priors.note: household / workplace relationship priors, the only non-experience source; everything else must be earned by an event

threat_seed.note: the busiest shop is the building with the most open customer work sessions at the first game minute at or after 10.5833h in which any customer session exists; ties by lowest building id, index case = lowest customer id there

relationships.note: a pair counts as changed when familiarity / trust / affinity / obligation differs from the value it held at boot (the household / workplace prior), i.e. an event moved it; pairs that only ever received a prior do not count

rumor.note: hops is the depth stamped on the telling; the runtime refuses a third hop (social.MAX_HOPS = 2), one telling of one origin fact per (sender, recipient) pair ever, and one telling per pair per 30 minutes

houston.counts_note: `counts` are the runtime's persistent counters (every occurrence, including the low-salience rows that are counted without emitting an event); `story_counts` are the events actually emitted and drained

seeding_run1.note: the busiest shop is the building with the most open customer work sessions at the first game minute at or after 10.5833h in which any customer session exists; ties by lowest building id, index case = lowest customer id there

seeding_run2.note: the busiest shop is the building with the most open customer work sessions at the first game minute at or after 10.5833h in which any customer session exists; ties by lowest building id, index case = lowest customer id there

determinism.note: two freshly built worlds booted at 5:00, each seeding the stressor by the same rule at the same game minute and advancing 3 further game hours; the full cognition event lists are compared verbatim plus a digest of every fact of every citizen and every relationship dimension
